## Change
Describe the user-visible change and its purpose.

## Ownership
- [ ] Engine
- [ ] CLI
- [ ] Website
- [ ] Shared contract or migration

## Verification
List commands run and observed results. State skipped integration checks and the reason.

## Compatibility
Describe API/schema/CLI changes and migration steps, or state that existing interfaces are preserved.

## Screenshots
Include desktop/mobile screenshots for UI changes.

## Checklist
- [ ] Relevant documentation and completion checklist updated
- [ ] No secrets, local configuration, model weights or dependencies committed
- [ ] Permission decisions remain enforced by the engine/control plane
- [ ] Errors, cancellation and unavailable-service states handled where applicable
- [ ] Shared API changes coordinated with both clients
